```sql SELECT e.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount  FROM employees e  JOIN orders o ON e.emp_id = o.emp_id  GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.name  HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 0; ```
```sql SELECT name FROM employees WHERE dept_id IN (SELECT dept_id FROM departments WHERE budget > 100000) ```
```sql SELECT d.dept_name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name; ```
```sql SELECT name  FROM employees  WHERE emp_id NOT IN (SELECT emp_id FROM orders); ```
SELECT d.dept_name  FROM departments d  JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id  GROUP BY d.dept_name  ORDER BY SUM(e.salary) DESC  LIMIT 1;
```sql SELECT customer, COUNT(*) AS order_count  FROM orders  GROUP BY customer  HAVING COUNT(*) > 2; ```
```sql SELECT e.name AS emp_name, m.name AS manager_name FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.manager_id IS NOT NULL; ```
SELECT e.name  FROM employees e  WHERE e.salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id)
```sql SELECT      e.name,      e.dept_id,      DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.dept_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS salary_rank FROM      employees e; ```

```sql SELECT d.dept_name  FROM departments d  JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id  JOIN orders o ON e.emp_id = o.emp_id  GROUP BY d.dept_name  HAVING SUM(o.amount) > 5000; ```
